title: Fix FIDO2 detection freezing on macOS

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: The brew ssh-keygen probe actually invokes key generation which blocks waiting for a FIDO touch. Fix: detect brew openssh by checking for ssh-sk-helper in the same libexec dir instead of running keygen.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Fixed: detect brew openssh via ssh-sk-helper presence instead of running ssh-keygen. No blocking, no FIDO touch during detection.
